# Establishment log — bardo-thodol-005 (pp. 45–54), 2026-11-21

Read by three readers (strongest model; pp. 45–47, 48–50, 51–54.1), each checking the stored dzogchengonpa.org witness
line by line against crops of the page images (×3, ×5–×12 on doubt). Five print lines on every page; the witness's line
breaks match the print on all 46 lines read. The part begins with རང་གི་རིག་པའི་རང་མདངས་སུ་མ་ཤེས་ན་ནི༔ on p. 45 l. 1 (the
rest of that line after bardo-thodol-004's …སངས་རྒྱས་པར་འགྱུར་རོ༔) and ends at …ཁྱོད་རང་ལ་ | འཆར་དུ་འོང་ངོ༔ on p. 54 l. 1:
no ༔ on p. 53 closes a sentence after the description of Amoghasiddhi begins, so the sentence is finished from p. 54;
the rest of 54.1 (སེམས་དཔའ་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་དང༔ …) begins bardo-thodol-006.
Image overruled the witness: 12 (A) + 14 (B) + 17 (C) = 43. [?]: 3 (49.2 པ, tsheg unseen; 53.5 ཁྲིལ, tsheg unseen; 54.1 སྒྲིབ་པ, cut off from this part).

## Decisions taken when assembling (for the drafter)

  འོངྶ (49.5); one tsheg dropped mid-line, དེ་ཙན → དེ་ཙ་ན (50.1; the print writes དེ་ཙ་ན at 44.3); tsheg unseen at 53.5
  ཁྲིལ → ཁྲི་ལ ("on the throne", [?]); tshegs missing at line joins: སོགས་པའི|སྐལ, དེ་ལ|མ་འཇིགས, ཁྱོད|ཡི་དྭགས, འཁྱམས|པའི,
  རྡོ|རྗེ. Every fix was checked to apply once.
- Treated as clear misprints (README rule 5b; each unit's note must name the print's reading):
  - 49.3 བཀྲག་མད་པ → བཀྲག་མེད་པ ("dull": no vowel on the image; the print has བཀྲག་མེད at 44.1, 49.5–50.1, 50.5; the other

  - 49.2 ཐད་དཀར → ཐད་ཀར ("straight at": the print's same phrase at 43.5 is ཐད་ཀར, as the other recension here; དཀར
    "white" gives no sense).
- Kept as printed, with a note (the same slips were kept in 004, or more than one reading is possible):
  - ཀྱིས for the genitive ཀྱི: 48.5 འཇའ་འོད་ཀྱིས་ཀློང, 50.4 མཐའ་ཡས་ཀྱིས་ཐུགས་རྗེ, 51.2 ཡི་དྭགས་ཀྱིས་གནས (other recension ཀྱི
    each time; cf. 43.3 in 004).
  - 50.2 རིགས་པ for རིག་པ "awareness" (as the one-off spelling noted in 002).
  - 48.1 མིང་ནས་བོད for འབོད "call" (53.2 has འབོད).
  - 47.2–3 དབང་པོ་ཇི་ལྟར་གཞན་ཡང "however dull the faculties": the sense wants ཞན་ཀྱང (the other recension); the letters are
    clear and the correction is not one way. Translate by sense, note.
  - མཚེར for འཚེར at 46.2 (སེར་ལ་མཚེར, as four times in 004); the print has འཚེར elsewhere on these pages.
  - ང standing directly before ༔ (དང༔, ངོ༔): the print's habit, no fix.

## The readers' logs

### read_A-log.md

# read_A — pp. 45–47 (leaves n46–n48), established from the images

Line counts: p. 45 has five lines (a leaf front, opens ༄༅༔ ༔). p. 46 has five lines (a leaf back, no ornament). p. 47 has five lines (a leaf front, opens ༄༅༔ ༔). That makes 15 print lines.
The witness's line breaks match the print on every line (15 of 15).

**Part seam.** 45.1 is written in full. The text up to and including …སངས་རྒྱས་པར་འགྱུར་རོ༔ belongs to part 004 (see read_C). This part starts at རང་གི་རིག་པའི་རང་མདངས་སུ་མ་ཤེས་ན་ནི༔.

Method: line bands were found from the frame rules (top and bottom rule, divided into five bands). Each line was cropped in thirds at ×3. Every doubtful syllable was checked at ×6–×10 (LANCZOS), and a few at pixel level.

**Tshegs.** At this scan resolution, many tshegs between tightly set letters merge into the headline. Examples are 45.2 ཡིན་ནོ་སྐྱབས, 45.2 ནི་བཅོམ, and 45.3 འོང་བ་ཡིན་ནོ. Where the syllable division can only go one way, I keep the witness's tsheg without a [?]. I leave a tsheg out only where the letters plainly lack one and the result is a real form (a contraction, or ང directly before ༔).

**བ / པ.** At ×3 to ×6 the two are often indistinguishable. Where the image does not settle it, I take the witness (45.4 ཡིན་བའི, 47.5 བྲོས་བས).

## Suspected misprints (kept as printed)

1. 47.2–47.3 དབང་པོ་ཇི་ལྟར་གཞན་ཡང་གྲོལ་བར: the sense calls for ཇི་ལྟར་ཞན་ཀྱང ("however dull the faculties"), which is what the other recension has. The print's གཞན་ཡང ("others too") reads awkwardly, but the letters are clear (×3). Certainty is moderate, and more than one correction is possible. Kept, note only.

Not misprints, the print's own spelling: བ for པ (45.4 ཡིན་བའི, 47.5 བྲོས་བས); མཚེར་བ (46.2); བལྟ for ལྟ (46.1); ཐོབ for བཏབ in the formula "pray thus" (45.2, 46.3; shared with the other recension); the contraction མེདོ (47.3).

## Where the other recension differs in sense (print followed)

- 45.1: print མ་ཤེས་ན་ནི; other recension ངོ་མ་ཤེས་ན་ནི. Same sense.
- 45.4: print ལྕགས་ཀྱུ་ཡིན་བའི་མོས་པ་གྱིས་ཤིག; other recension ལྕགས་ཀྱུ་ཡིན་པས་མོས་པ་གྱིས་ཤིག. The print's form is attributive ("make the devotion [that recognises it] as the hook"); the other's is causal ("since it is the hook, have devotion").
- 45.4–45.5: print ཁྱོད་ཀྱི་ང་རྒྱལ…བག་ཆགས་ཀྱི་བསུ་བའི་ལམ་ཡིན་ནོ; other recension དེ་ཁྱོད་ཀྱི…བག་ཆགས་ཀྱིས་བསུ་མའི་འོད་ལམ་ཡིན་ནོ. In the print it is "the path"; in the other recension it is "the light-path".
- 45.5: print ཁྱོད་མིའི་གནས་སུ་ལྟུང་ནས … ཉམས་སུ་མྱོང; other recension ཁྱེད … ལྷུང … མྱོང (no ཉམས་སུ). Same sense.
- 46.1: print འཁོར་བའི་འདམ་ནས་ཐོན་པའི་དུས ("time of getting out of the swamp of saṃsāra"); other recension འཁོར་བའི་གནས་ནས་ཐར་བའི་དུས ("place … being freed"). The image differs.
- 46.1: print ལམ་བཀག་པའི ("blocks the path"); other recension ལམ་འགག་པའི. Same sense.
- 46.1: print མིག་མི་བལྟ་བར; other recension མིག་གིས་མ་ལྟ་བར. Same sense.
- 46.2: print མ་ཆགས་ཤིག༔ མ་ཞེན་ཅིག; other recension དེ་ལ་མ་ཆགས་ཤིག་མ་ཞེན་ཅིག. Same sense.
- 46.2: print འོད་སེར་པོ་སེར་ལ་མཚེར་བ…མོས་པ་གྱིས་ཤིག༔; other recension འོད་སེར་པོ་གསལ་ལ་འཚེར་བ…མོས་པ་གྱིས་ལ. The epithet differs ("yellow and shimmering" against "clear and shimmering").

## Suspected misprints (kept as printed)

1. 49.3 བཀྲག་མད་པ, which should be བཀྲག་མེད་པ. Certainty is high: the vowel is absent on the image, and the phrase is "dull, lustreless". The print has བཀྲག་མེད at 44.1, 49.5/50.1 and 50.5, and the other recension has བཀྲག་མེད་པ. Proposed: `# fix: བཀྲག་མད་པ => བཀྲག་མེད་པ`.
2. 50.2 རིག་པ is spelled རིགས་པ ("awareness"; cf. 44.4 རིག་པ་བྱར་མེད in the print). Certainty is moderate to high on sense. Proposed: `# fix: ཏུ་རིགས་པ་བྱར => ཏུ་རིག་པ་བྱར`. This one is the drafter's choice.
3. 49.2 ཐད་དཀར, which should be ཐད་ཀར (the print has ཐད་ཀར at 43.5; the other recension has ཐད་ཀར). Certainty is moderate. Possible `# fix: ཐད་དཀར་མིག => ཐད་ཀར་མིག`.
4. 48.5 འཇའ་འོད་ཀྱིས་ཀློང and 50.4 མཐའ་ཡས་ཀྱིས་ཐུགས་རྗེ: an instrumental before a noun, where the genitive ཀྱི is meant. The other recension has ཀྱི in both places. This is the same kind of slip as read_C's 43.3. Certainty is moderate. Possible fixes, which are the drafter's choice: `# fix: འོད་ཀྱིས་ཀློང => འོད་ཀྱི་ཀློང` and `# fix: ཡས་ཀྱིས་ཐུགས => ཡས་ཀྱི་ཐུགས`.
5. 48.1 བོད for འབོད: "call" (the print has འབོད at 42.4). བོད is not a misprint; it is a known variant of the verb. Kept, note only.

Not misprints, the print's own spelling: བ for པ (49.1 རྟོགས་བའི); གཅིག/ཅིག for ཞིག (49.2, 49.3); གཤིབས་མར beside 44.1 གཤིབ་མར; the goddess names གྷཱིརྟི and ཨཱ་ལོ་ཀེ.

The witness's line breaks match the print on every line read (16 of 16).

**End of the stretch.** p. 53 l.5 ends …ཞལ་སྦྱར་ནས་ཁྱོད་རང་ལ་ | 54.1 འཆར་དུ་འོང་ངོ༔. The stretch ends at the first ༔ on 54.1. For the doubtful letter, see 54.1 below: the print reads **འོང**. The rest of 54.1 (སེམས་དཔའ་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་དང༔ … ཀྱིས་བསྐོར་) is transcribed in full, as asked.

Method: line bands were located from the row profile (headlines n52 at y≈137/191/249/301/356, n53 127/181/236/290/346, n54 148/205/260/316/370, n55 119). Each line was cropped in four overlapping segments at ×3 (LANCZOS), and every doubtful syllable at ×6–×12. The scan is bilevel and this cut's tshegs are very small. A tsheg is therefore judged absent only where the letters touch or there is visibly no room for one.

(16 rows, 17 changes: the 54.1 row འོད → འོང also removes the tsheg before ༔. In all: 10 letter changes (4 on p. 51; 53.4 ཡོད; 53.5 བསྣམས, ཡུམ; 54.1 འོང, པ, བར), 3 line-end tsheg removals, 4 tsheg-before-༔ removals (53.2; 54.1 ×3).)

Witness readings checked and confirmed, though they look odd:
- 51.2 ཡི་དྭགས་ཀྱིས་གནས་སུ: the ས after ཀྱི is clear (×7). See misprints.
- 51.2 ལྷུང (ha subscript; the other recension has ལྟུང).
- 51.3 ཆགས་སེམས་སྤོངས (the other recension has བག་ཆགས་སྤོངས).
- 51.3 མོས་པ་གྱིས་ལ: the stack is ག (box head) and matches སྐོམ་གྱི in 51.2, not ཀྱི in 51.1 (side by side at ×6). The other recension has the same.
- 51.3 འཚེར་བ (with འ; this print elsewhere writes མཚེར་བ).
- 52.3 སྐུ་རུ: a second zhabs-kyu under ར (×6).
- 52.4 ཡུན་རིང་པའི: a tsheg plus two filler dots stand mid-line after རིང (a gap in the block, ×6). The fillers are left out.
- 52.4 དངངས་སྐྲག (ད ང ང ས, ×6; དངངས is the ordinary spelling of "terror", the other recension has སྔངས).
- 53.1 བྱོན་ནོ༔ (×6).
- 53.5 ནམ་མཁའ་ལྡིང: two མ, each with its own loop (×6). It is not the ནམཁའ contraction.
- 54.1 གྷནྡྷེ: two stacks, ག+ཧ, then ན+ད+ཧ with e (×6).
- 54.1 ནཱིར་ཏི (a-chung under ན; no tsheg visible between ནཱི and ར).
- 54.1 ཀྱིས་བསྐོར.

## [?] (2)

- 53.5 ཁྲིལ[?]་བཞུགས: at ×12 no tsheg can be seen between ཁྲི and ལ. The tail of the gi-gu comes down exactly where a tsheg would stand, so a worn or hidden tsheg cannot be ruled out. The witness has ཁྲིལ, and that is taken. The sense is ཁྲི་ལ ("on the throne"; the other recension has ཁྲི་ལ). See the fix below.
- 54.1 སྒྲིབ་པ[?]: the letter after སྒྲིབ་ (×8) has its top-right corner open, like the པ of དཔའ in the same line (×7). The བ directly before it, and the བ of བར/སེལ་བ, are closed boxes. The witness has བ, and the print does write བ for པ elsewhere (བར in the same line). I lean to པ (as in the other recension, སྒྲིབ་པ), but the difference is a couple of pixels.

Close calls not marked [?]:
- 53.5 (line end) ལ་: a small point at headline height just after ལ, before the frame. It could be the tip of the ལ head or a tsheg. The witness's tsheg is kept.
- 53.4 ཡོད / 54.1 འོང: in this cut ད and ང have nearly the same shape (head bar, left drop, diagonal down-right). Each is decided by the evidence in its row above, not by the shape alone.
- Line-end tshegs elsewhere (51.2, 51.3, 51.5, 52.1–52.5, 53.1–53.3, 54.1) are visible as the first of the dots, or as a single dot before the frame. They are kept.

## Fixes needed (`# fix:` lines)

```
# fix: ཁྱོདཡི་དྭགས => ཁྱོད་ཡི་དྭགས
# fix: འཁྱམསཔའི་ཚེ => འཁྱམས་པའི་ཚེ
# fix: རྡོརྗེ་རྒྱ་གྲམ => རྡོ་རྗེ་རྒྱ་གྲམ
# fix: ཁྲིལ་བཞུགས => ཁྲི་ལ་བཞུགས
```
- 51.1→51.2, 51.4→51.5, 53.4→53.5: there is no tsheg at the line end (the letter meets the frame). None of these joins crosses a page-opening ornament.
- 53.5 ཁྲིལ: if the drafter takes it as a worn tsheg rather than a contraction, the fix is the same.
- If the [?] at 54.1 is resolved to the witness (བ): `# fix: སྒྲིབ་བ་རྣམ => སྒྲིབ་པ་རྣམ` would then be a misprint correction, not a reading. With པ as read, nothing is needed.

No line-end abbreviations (པའཾ, ལཾ, ནམཁའ, subscript-ས) occur on these pages.

## Suspected misprints (kept as printed)

1. 51.2 ཡི་དྭགས་ཀྱིས་གནས་སུ, which should be ཀྱི ("into the realm of the pretas"). An instrumental makes no sense before གནས, and the other recension has ཀྱི. Certainty is moderate: it is the same kind of slip as 43.3 ཀྱིས་སྐུ and 35.1 གྱིས་དབང. Possible `# fix: དྭགས་ཀྱིས་གནས => དྭགས་ཀྱི་གནས`. This is the drafter's choice.
2. 54.1 རྣམ་བར་སེལ་བ (for རྣམ་པར): not a misprint, the print's བ-for-པ habit. Note only.
3. 53.5 ཁྲིལ: see the fix above (a contraction or a lost tsheg, not a wrong letter).

Not misprints, the print's own spelling: དངངས (52.4), སྤོངས (51.3), ལྷུང (51.2), ནཱིར་ཏི / གྷནྡྷེ (transliterated goddess names; the other recension has ནིརྟི, གནྡྷེ).

## Where the other recension differs in sense (print followed)

- 51.1: print དེ་ནི་…བསགས་པའི་ཡི་དྭགས་ཀྱི་བསུ་བའི་ལམ ("the welcoming path of the pretas"); other recension དེ་ཁྱོད་ཀྱི་…བསགས་པའི་བག་ཆགས་ཀྱི་བསུ་མའི་ལམ ("of the habitual tendencies").
- 51.3: print ཆགས་སེམས་སྤོངས ("give up the attached mind"); other recension བག་ཆགས་སྤོངས ("give up the tendencies").
- 51.4: print རྩེ་གཅིག་གཏོད་ལ / སྐད་དུ་ཐོབ; other recension རྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ་གཏོད་ལ / སྐད་ཐོབ. Same sense.
- 51.5–52.1: print བསྐྱོར / བསྐྱོལ; other recension སྐྱོར / སྐྱོལ. Same.
- 52.2: print འོད་དཔག་མེད་ཀྱི་ཐུགས་ཀར; other recension འོད་དཔག་མེད་ཡབ་ཡུམ་གྱི་ཐུགས་ཀར (adds "father-mother").
- 52.3: print སྐུ་རུ / དེས་ནི; other recension སྐུར / དེས. Same.
- 52.3–4: print ཡང་དེ་ལྟར་དུ…ཡུན་རིང་པའི་སྟབས་ཀྱིས་བག་ཆགས་མི་སྤོང་བར; other recension ཡང་འདི་ལྟར…ཡུན་རིང་པའི་དབང་གིས་བག་ཆགས་མ་སྤངས་བར. Close in sense.
- 52.5: print མི་ཟིན / ཞག་ལྔ་པའི / ཡང་དེའི་ཚེ; other recension མ་ཟིན / ལྔ་བའི / དེའི་ཚེ. Same.
- 53.1: print ལྷ་ཚོགས་ཐུགས་རྗེའི…བསུ་བ་ལ་བྱོན་ནོ༔ (sentence ends); other recension ལྷ་ཚོགས་ཀྱི་ཐུགས་རྗེའི…བསུ་མ་ལ་བྱོན་ཏེ༔ (continues).
- 53.3: print རླུང་ཐམས་ཅད་རྣམ་པར་དག་པའི ("all wind"); other recension རླུང་རྣམ་པར་དག་པའི (cf. 42.4 in part 004, same pattern).
- 53.4: print རབ་བརྩེགས་པའི་ཞིང་ཁམས ("the realm Heaped Up"); other recension རབ་རྫོགས་པའི ("Fully Accomplished"). **The name of the realm differs.** The letters བརྩེགས are clear in the print.
- 53.4: print adds གཙོ་འཁོར ("chief and retinue") after དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པ.
- 53.5: print ནམ་མཁའ་ལྡིང / ཁྲིལ / ཞལ་སྦྱར / ཁྱོད་རང་ལ; other recension མཁའ་ལྡིང / ཁྲི་ལ / ཞལ་སྦྱོར / རང་ལ. Same sense.
- 54.1: print སྒྲིབ་པ་རྣམ་བར་སེལ་བ; other recension སྒྲིབ་པ་རྣམ་སེལ. Same bodhisattva (Sarvanivaraṇaviṣkambhin).
